value.rationale: A complete distribution for the canonical uniform random binary automaton model, stratified by the mathematically central strongly connected subclass, supplies an exact finite benchmark for random synchronization studies. It resolves all 17 reset-time categories, a sharp 10-versus-11 connectivity support transition, nontrivial exact conditional mean disparity (4.5313 versus 3.3436), and nonsynchronizing masses—not merely a textbook deduction of known high-tail examples. It is a natural full census with reproducible two-method proof, while no asymptotic consequence is claimed.
